introduction_section.heading: What is
content: At Devisgon, we believe a logo is much more than just an attractive graphic. It is the face of your business, the visual cornerstone of your brand, and the first thing potential customers will use to judge your credibility.

We strictly avoid generic templates and clip art. Instead, we dive deep into your brand's core values, target market, and industry positioning to craft original, vector-based designs that look just as crisp on a smartphone screen as they do on a massive billboard.
introduction_section.highlight_quote: “Your logo is the silent ambassador of your brand.”

faq_section.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_section.subtitle: Get answers to common branding questions

questions.question: What is the difference between a logo and a brand identity?
questions.answer: A logo is the single visual mark or symbol used to identify your business. A brand identity encompasses the logo, but also includes your color palette, typography, brand voice, and guidelines on how to use them together.

questions.question: Will I own the copyright to my logo?
questions.answer: Yes! Once the project is complete and fully paid for, full ownership and copyright of the final logo design are transferred completely to you.

questions.question: What if I don't like any of the initial concepts?
questions.answer: Our discovery process is designed to prevent this, but if the first round misses the mark, we will use your feedback to pivot and create new concepts. We include revision rounds to ensure you are 100% happy with the final result.

questions.question: What files will I receive at the end?
questions.answer: You will receive a complete package containing vector files (AI, EPS, SVG) which can be scaled infinitely without losing quality, as well as standard raster files (transparent PNG, JPG) for web and social media use.
